metadata.title: ec-jrc/lisflood-utilities: A set of utilities for lisflood users
metadata.description: Lisflood‑utilities is a set of utilities for lisflood users: define_waterregions, verify_waterregions, cutmaps, catchstats, compare, decumulate, gridding, lfcoords, mctrivers, nc2pcr, pcr2nc, ncextract, download_timeseries, rainbomb, thresholds, generate_neighbours.
